main_finding: R3C moved Magic Key from an abstract lifecycle planner to a real proof-carrying executable package chain. On the frozen finite Boolean trajectory, ROBDD seed compilation, ROBDD restriction, ROBDD-to-D_DNNF translation and D_DNNF conditioning were accepted only after independent exact replay using self-contained semantic fallback. Verification cost remained explicitly charged and dominated producer work in this small test, demonstrating the intended NO_FREE_SEMANTIC_COMPRESSION accounting discipline.
important_negative_control: A forged receipt claiming PASS but carrying the wrong package hash was rejected before any next package was materialized.
interpretation: This is the first executable research prototype of the future TRUMP computational ABI inside Fundamentum, not a TRUMP release and not evidence that SAT is in P.
next_frontier: Broaden from one frozen finite trajectory to adversarial portability and lifecycle attacks: corrupted/stale/replayed receipts, backend/version changes, cross-process and cross-machine replay, larger semantic objects, multiple representation switches, deliberate UNKNOWN/debt injection, certificate-size versus verification-cost scaling, and trajectories where NO_CERTIFIED_CHEAP_ROUTE is the expected exact result.
